description: make.fun's competition prize escrow on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.2.1): a sponsor funds a vault, a resolver posts a merkle payout root with a bond, a challenge window passes, settle makes it claimable and winners claim with merkle proofs. The full open → post → settle → claim path was verified with exact payouts.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of makedotfun/prize-escrow. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/prize-escrow. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and builds with upstream's devnet-only test-windows feature (60 s windows instead of hours) and --arch v2. The hosted IDL is the upstream IDL with the lab address substituted. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (escrow funding, payout-root commitments, challenge window, merkle claims)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/prize-escrow/
QA: devnet proof of a funded escrow paid out to two winners
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise challenge_commit, challenge_reveal and attest on a disputed result
